title: Felt Bicycles Announce Recall to Repair Mountain Bicycles for Brake Failure
summary: The steel brake boss can detach from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 700.

title: Lexar JumpDrive® Computer Storage Devices Recalled for Burn Hazard, Certain Models Involved
summary: The recalled JumpDrives® FireFly and Secure II products could overheat, posing a risk of burns to consumers and property damage. Units: About 66,000.

title: Heat & Glo Indoor/Outdoor Gas Fireplaces Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: Temperatures in the framing header area above these fireplaces can get too high, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,550 units.

title: Home Fragrance Holdings, Inc. Recalls Candles Sold at Pier 1 Imports Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candles can unexpectedly flare, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 413,000 candles.

title: Small World Toys Recalls Toy Vehicles for Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic wheels on the toys can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 92,300.

title: Tiffany and Company Recalls Paloma Rattles for Aspiration, Laceration Hazards
summary: Seams on the rattle can open during use, releasing small round beads. The beads can pose an aspiration hazard to young children. The breakage also can create ragged edges on the ring, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 47.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles for Fire Hazard
summary: The operator could ride with their foot engaging the rear brake without noticing. This can cause the rear brake to overheat and, possibly, ignite, posing a risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 11,300.

title: Hair Dryers Recalled for Electrocution Hazard
summary: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection plug to prevent electrocution if the hair dryer falls into water. Such electric shock protection devices are required by industry standards for all electric hand-held hair dryers. Units: About 19,300.

title: IKEA Home Furnishings Announces Recall to Repair Folding Chair Beds and Sofa Beds for Fingertip Amputation Hazard
summary: Fingers can become caught in the folding mechanism of the chair bed/sofa bed, posing a laceration and/or amputation hazard. Units: About 100,000.

title: Plastic Hardware Covers on Children's Furniture Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The small cam lock covers can be easily removed, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,200 pieces.

title: Suunto Dive Computers Recalled Due to Decompression Hazard
summary: These dive computers could incorrectly track dive time, which could cause incorrect calculation of decompression requirements. This could lead to decompression sickness. Units: About 3,900.

title: Humidifiers Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: Water from the humidifier can leak into the unit's electrical compartment, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,000.

title: Bear Archery Recalls Compound Crossbows Due to Faulty Trigger Mechanisms
summary: The triggers on these crossbows could fire when the safety mechanism is moved from "safe" to "fire" position without pulling the trigger. Bystanders could be unintentionally hit by an arrow fired by these bows. Units: About 2,000.

title: Ryobi Radial Arm Saws Recalled for Blade Detachment Hazard
summary: Cracking of the plastic motor housing can cause the blade assembly to fall during operation, posing a risk of laceration to the operator or bystanders. The detachment may occur unexpectedly and without warning. Units: About 145,000.

title: Sportsstuff Wego Kite Tubes Withdrawn from Market after Reports of Deaths and Injuries
summary: A rider in the tube can become airborne, by pulling on handles attached to the floor of the tube. That could result in serious injuries. Units: About 19,000.

title: M2Racer LLC Recalls Bicycle Headsets for Fall Hazard
summary: The headsets mount to bicycle frames and fasten to the front fork assembly. A protruding component of the headset can contact the steering tube of the front fork assembly, score or scratch the steering tube, and weaken the structural integrity of the front fork. title: Shimano American Corp. Recalls Quick-Release Device for Bicycles Posing Fall Hazard
summary: The quick release skewers can unexpectedly fail or break, when locked in position. When this happens, the rider could lose control and fall. Units: About 8,500.

title: Husqvarna Outdoor Products Inc. Recalls Lawn Tractors for Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel line on these lawn tractors can separate from the fuel tank outlet. If this occurs, fuel will spill out, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 174,000.

title: Office Chairs Sold at Wal-Mart Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: The legs and backs of these chairs can break, and the chairs can easily tip over, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 762,000.

title: Generac Power Systems Inc. Recalls Engines to Replace Fuel Tanks Due to Risk of Fire
summary: The plastic fuel tanks can leak. If an ignition source is present, a fire or explosion can occur. Units: About 700.

title: Meijer Recalls Glass Candleholders for Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The glue connecting the candleholder could fail, causing the candleholder to fall apart. This poses a fire and laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,500.

title: Bunn-O-Matic Corp. Expands Recall of Home Coffeemakers Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The coffeemaker's plastic pour-in bowl and lid can melt or ignite due to an electrical failure, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 561,000 (This recall was first announced in June 2005).

title: Children's Lamp Sold at The Home Depot® Recalled for Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass window of the fire truck and bulldozer night light can become dislodged, fall and shatter into small pieces. This poses a laceration hazard and a serious risk of injury, if ingested by a small child. Units: About 9,500.

title: Deere & Co. Recall Compact Utility Tractors for Seat Belt Bracket Failure Hazard
summary: The seat bracket, to which the seat belt is attached, could have been positioned incorrectly during the manufacturing process, resulting in a poor weld. In a tractor roll over, the weight of the operator could cause the bracket to break off the seat's pivot plate. Units: About 2,800.

title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The mounting brackets used to secure the left-front suspension arm to the ATV frame may not have been welded completely and could break off during riding. If this occurs, the rider could lose control of the ATV and crash, posing a risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 300.
